script: Her "big penis myth" turned into a confession that shattered everything.. I started dating her two months ago, but we'd only been talking for three. She's got a rough past—she said she was raped by her only ex, so I kept that out of our chats. One night we slipped into a weird talk about penis size. She asked why black guys supposedly have bigger ones. I said "too big" can be a downside; some women hate big. She said "No, big is better." I asked her what "big" means. She said 17-18 cm. I said that's just above average. She said all her friends have partners with at least 17-18 cm. I said that doesn't prove it's average. Then she went, "If a guy's under 16 cm, he should be insecure." I asked about her ex's size, and she laughed, "Oh, it was 19 cm, we measured it together." My blood boiled. How could she talk about her rapist's size like that? I felt disgust, wanted to vomit. I hung up, told her it made me sick. I loved her for a lot of reasons, but after that call I broke up. She seemed unfazed, but I couldn't shake it. I am 6 inches, never insecure, but she rattled my head. I am not sure if I overreacted or if it was right. I just know I can't love her the same way again. I am 18, she's 18. We're both at the start of everything, but her audacity with that ex—talking about a rape like a joke—felt like a betrayal. I can't get it out of my mind. I wonder if I could've handled it differently, or if ending was the only way.
